insights.topic: Verified purchase signals vs. probabilistic targeting
insights.insight: The network has produced 16,901 cryptographically verified purchase events across $1.056M in confirmed GMV — deterministic signals that confirm a transaction occurred, not inferred intent from browsing behavior. For marketers paying $5+ CPM on probabilistic audiences, this represents a structurally different input: proof of purchase, not prediction of purchase.

7-day GMV has fallen from a $210,912 peak on April 13 to $76,909 as of April 29 — a 64% contraction in rolling weekly volume in under three weeks. The network is still generating inflow every cycle, but any marketer evaluating signal volume for campaign planning should model against current throughput, not the April peak.

Google appeared in the 14-day top brand list on April 28, the first digital-native brand to reach that threshold in network history — following SaaS-subscription receipts first appearing April 9. The verified receipt model is beginning to capture digital transaction proof, expanding the addressable use case beyond physical retail.

Department stores and grocery are nearly tied on 14-day GMV ($37,937 vs. $37,895), but grocery runs 34% more receipts — meaning department store baskets are materially larger per transaction. Brands in home goods, apparel, and general merchandise have a higher-value verified buyer signal available than receipt volume alone would suggest.

The network reached 17 active CBSAs in a single heartbeat on April 18, with 81% diffusion — the highest geographic spread rate recorded. For brand marketers, this indicates the verified signal base is not concentrated in one or two metros, which matters for national campaign targeting and regional audience construction.

insights.topic: Data quality gap in the Unknown category
insights.insight: 10.2% of 14-day receipts — 469 transactions representing $26,511 in GMV — carry no category classification. For any marketer building audience segments from this data, one in ten signals currently cannot be attributed to a vertical, which is a material gap in targeting precision that should be resolved before scaling spend against this feed.
